# Load packages Load packages
```{r}
library(pacman)
p_load(cols4all, ggplot2, dplyr, patchwork, tidyverse, scales, broomstringr, ggforce)

```

# Overview of functional annotations
```{r}
# Set variables
input <- "result/07_humann2/KEGG_L1_L2.txt"
group <- "All"
top <- 50

# Read files Read files
dt <- read.table(input, header = T, sep = "\t")

dt_ord <- head(dt[order(dt[,group],decreasing = TRUE),], top)

dt_ord <- distinct(dt_ord, dt_ord[,2], .keep_all = T)


dt_ord <- dt_ord[order(dt_ord[,1],decreasing = TRUE),]

dt_ord[,2] <- factor(dt_ord[,2], levels = rev(dt_ord[,2]))
dt_ord[,1] <- factor(dt_ord[,1], levels = unique(dt_ord[,1]))

mycol <- c4a('bold',length(unique(dt_ord[,1])))

colnames(dt_ord) <- c("Pathway_L1", "Pathway_L2", "group")


# Generate a basic bar plot
p <- ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = dt_ord,
           aes(x = scale(group), y = Pathway_L2, fill = Pathway_L1),
           stat = "identity") + xlab("count") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) + scale_fill_manual(values = mycol)

# Save the figure
filename = paste0("result/07_humann2/", group,  "_kegg_L1_L2_top", top, ".pdf")
ggsave(filename, p, width = 10, height = 10)

```


# Differential metabolic pathways
## Comparison group A
```{r}
# Set group names
Group_1 <- "Jiangmen"
Group_2 <- "Zhongshan"
Group <- "Location"
top <- 10
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Step 1: Read data
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pathways <- read.table("result/07_humann2/KEGG.Pathway.raw.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# metadata grouping information
metadata <- read.table("result/metadata.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

if (Group != "Group") {
  if ("Group" %in% names(metadata)) {
    metadata$Group <- NULL 
  }
  names(metadata)[names(metadata) == Group] <- "Group"
}


# Filter data for the comparison groups
pathways_sel <- select(pathways,Pathway,filter(metadata, Group %in% c(Group_1, Group_2) )[[1]])

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Step 2: Data preparation and statistical analysis
# ---------------------------------------------------------
df <- pathways_sel %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Pathway, names_to = "SampleID", values_to = "Abundance") %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "SampleID") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = c(Group_1, Group_2)))

# Calculate the mean and standard error for each group (for plotting the left-hand bar plot)
bar_data <- df %>%
  group_by(Pathway, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Abundance),
    SE = sd(Abundance) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Use Welch's t-test to calculate the difference in means (Difference in mean) and 95% confidence intervals (for plotting the right-hand dot plot)
diff_data_all <- df %>%
  group_by(Pathway) %>%
  summarise(
    test_res = list(t.test(Abundance ~ Group)), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_value = map_dbl(test_res, ~.$p.value),
    diff_mean = map_dbl(test_res, ~.$estimate[1] - .$estimate[2]),
    conf_low = map_dbl(test_res, ~.$conf.int[1]),
    conf_high = map_dbl(test_res, ~.$conf.int[2])
  ) %>%
  select(-test_res) %>% 
  arrange(p_value)


write.table(diff_data_all, file = paste0("result/07_humann2/", Group_1, " vs ", Group_2,  "_KEGG_Differential_Analysis_Results.csv"), row.names = FALSE, sep = "\t", quote = F)

# Sort p-values in ascending order and select significantly different pathways
top_pathways <- diff_data_all %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  head(top) %>%
  pull(Pathway)

# Filter the data and set factor levels according to the sorted order to ensure consistent y-axis ordering across plots
bar_data <- bar_data %>% 
  filter(Pathway %in% top_pathways) %>%
  mutate(Pathway = factor(Pathway, levels = rev(top_pathways)))

diff_data <- diff_data_all %>% 
  filter(Pathway %in% top_pathways) %>%
  mutate(
    Pathway = factor(Pathway, levels = rev(top_pathways)),
    ColorGroup = ifelse(diff_mean > 0, paste0(Group_1, "_higher"), paste0(Group_2, "_higher"))
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Step 3: Construct visualization plots (with alternating gray backgrounds)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
my_colors <- setNames(
  c("#5086AB", "#F19454", "#5086AB", "#F19454"),
  c(Group_1, Group_2, paste0(Group_1, "_higher"), paste0(Group_2, "_higher"))
)

# 1. Create a data frame for plotting alternating gray backgrounds
num_pathways <- length(top_pathways)

# Generate coordinates for background rectangles: create a rectangle with a height of 1 for every other row
bg_data <- data.frame(
  xmin = seq(1, num_pathways, by = 2) - 0.5,
  xmax = seq(1, num_pathways, by = 2) + 0.5,
  ymin = -Inf,
  ymax = Inf
)

# Plot 1: Left-hand bar plot (Mean Abundance)
p1 <- ggplot(bar_data, aes(x = Pathway, y = Mean, fill = Group)) +
  geom_rect(data = bg_data, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
            fill = "#E5E5E5", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", 
           position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), 
           width = 0.7,
           linewidth = 0.4,
           color = "black") +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE),
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), 
                 color = "black", 
                 linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_scientific()) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.4, color = "black"),
    axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.4, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.8, "cm"),   
    legend.key.height = unit(0.25, "cm"), 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)  
  ) +
  labs(y = "Mean Abundance")

# Plot 2: Right-hand difference dot plot (Difference in mean abundance)
p2 <- ggplot(diff_data, aes(x = Pathway, y = diff_mean)) +
  geom_rect(data = bg_data, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
            fill = "#E5E5E5", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high), width = 0.4, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = ColorGroup), shape = 21, size = 3, color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_scientific()) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),     
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),    
    axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.4, color = "black"),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),     
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none"           
  ) +
  labs(y = "Difference in mean abundance")

# Combine the plots
final_plot <- p1 + p2 + plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1))

# Export as a high-resolution figure
ggsave(paste0("result/07_humann2/", Group_1, " vs ", Group_2, "_STAMP_plot_KEGG.pdf"), plot = final_plot, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

```

# humann2_pie
```{r}
# 1. Prepare data
raw_data <- read.delim("result/07_humann2/Enzyme_Contribution_pie.txt", header=TRUE)

# 2. Data cleaning and parsing
plot_data <- raw_data %>%
  # Split the species contribution strings
  mutate(Contribution = str_split(Contribution, ",\\s*")) %>%
  unnest(Contribution) %>%
  # Extract species names and numerical values
  extract(Contribution, into = c("Species", "Value"), regex = "(.*)\\((.*)\\)", convert = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(Enzyme, Abundance) %>%
  # Calculate the value of the "Others" category to ensure complete pie charts
  mutate(Known_Sum = sum(Value)) %>%
  group_modify(~ add_row(.x, Species = "Others", Value = max(0, .y$Abundance - .x$Known_Sum[1]))) %>%
  filter(Value > 0) %>% 
  ungroup()

# 3. Calculate the angular positions of the pie chart segments in radians
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(Enzyme) %>%
  mutate(
    focus = 0,
    end_angle = cumsum(Value) / Abundance * 2 * pi,
    start_angle = lag(end_angle, default = 0),
    # Set the radius based on the square root of the abundance index to ensure that the area is proportional to abundance
    radius = sqrt(Abundance) / 50 
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 4. Plotting
g <- ggplot(plot_data) +
  geom_arc_bar(aes(x0 = 0, y0 = 0, r0 = 0, r = radius,
                   start = start_angle, end = end_angle, fill = Species),
               color = "white", size = 0.001) +
  facet_wrap(~ Enzyme, ncol = 12) + # Arrange in 6 columns; adjust as needed
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "italic"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Enzyme Abundance and Microbial Contribution",
       fill = "Microbial Species") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma") # Use a high-contrast color palette

g
ggsave("result/07_humann2/enzyme_pies.pdf", g, width = 48, height = 40, limitsize = FALSE)
```
